title: SEC3: pool release uses closed fd as slot key
description: crypto2dev_pool_release() finds the pool slot by matching pool->slots[i].fd == slot_fd, but the caller has already called close(op_fd) before calling pool_release(). In a multi-threaded caller, the OS may recycle that fd number between close() and the pool slot scan, causing pool_release() to find and overwrite the wrong slot. Even single-threaded, the protocol is fragile: slot identity should be by index, not by fd value. Affects cipher path (lines 826-829), hash finalize (lines 941-944), and hash error path (lines 950-955).
